items.title: Desikan-Killiany 68-Region Cortical Parcellation Reference Atlas
items.attributionText: Desikan et al. (2006) NeuroImage; FreeSurfer / OpenNeuro BIDS parcellation metadata.
items.description: 34 gyral cortical regions per hemisphere with MNI152 centroids, surface areas, and TNA mappings.

items.title: Destrieux 148-Region Sulcal-Gyral Cortical Atlas Metadata
items.attributionText: Destrieux et al. (2010) NeuroImage; FreeSurfer a2009s parcellation table.
items.description: 74 sulcal and gyral cortical subdivisions per hemisphere following standard anatomical nomenclature.

items.title: HCP-MMP1.0 360-Area Multimodal Cortical Parcellation Index
items.attributionText: Glasser et al. (2016) Nature; Human Connectome Project multimodal parcellation taxonomy.
items.description: 180 multimodal cortical areas per hemisphere defined by architecture, function, connectivity, and topography.

items.title: Julich-Brain Probabilistic Cytoarchitectonic Region Summary
items.attributionText: Amunts et al. (2020) Science; EBRAINS Julich-Brain Cytoarchitectonic Atlas (CC BY 4.0).
items.description: Cytoarchitectonic laminar density profiles and probabilistic stereotaxic bounds across cortical and subcortical areas.

items.title: Allen Human Brain Atlas Anatomical Ontology & Ion-Channel Gene Expression Summary
items.attributionText: Allen Institute for Brain Science; Hawrylycz et al. (2012) Nature. Non-commercial educational citation required on same page.
items.description: Regionally aggregated transcriptomic expression profiles for major NaV, KV, CaV, AMPA, NMDA, and GABA receptor subunits.

items.title: NeuroMorpho Reconstructed Hippocampal CA1 Pyramidal Neuron (SWC)
items.attributionText: NeuroMorpho.Org (Ascoli et al., 2007); canonical CA1 pyramidal reconstruction.
items.description: 3D 7-column SWC morphological tree of a mammalian hippocampal CA1 pyramidal cell (soma, basal skirt, apical trunk, tuft).

items.title: NeuroMorpho Reconstructed Neocortical Layer 5 Thick-Tufted Pyramidal Cell (SWC)
items.attributionText: NeuroMorpho.Org (Ascoli et al., 2007); neocortical Layer 5B pyramidal reconstruction.
items.description: 3D SWC morphology of a Layer 5 thick-tufted pyramidal neuron used in Studio B and multi-compartment cable simulations.

items.title: NeuroMorpho Reconstructed Parvalbumin Fast-Spiking Basket Interneuron (SWC)
items.attributionText: NeuroMorpho.Org (Ascoli et al., 2007); cortical PV+ basket interneuron SWC reconstruction.
items.description: Multipolar aspiny dendritic tree and dense local perisomatic axonal arbor of a cortical PV+ basket cell.

items.title: NeuroMorpho Reconstructed Cerebellar Purkinje Neuron (SWC)
items.attributionText: NeuroMorpho.Org (Ascoli et al., 2007); planar cerebellar Purkinje cell arbor.
items.description: Planar high-branching dendritic fan of a cerebellar Purkinje neuron demonstrating Rall branching geometry.

items.title: NeuroMorpho Protoplasmic Astrocyte & Microglia Glial Reconstructions (SWC)
items.attributionText: NeuroMorpho.Org (Ascoli et al., 2007); CNS glial morphology reconstructions.
items.description: 3D morphological skeletons of a gray-matter protoplasmic astrocyte and a ramified parenchymal microglial cell.

items.title: Hodgkin-Huxley (1952) Squid Giant Axon Reference Action Potential Benchmark
items.attributionText: Hodgkin & Huxley (1952) J. Physiol. / ModelDB reference benchmark trace (McDougal et al., 2017).
items.description: High-precision reference traces of V(t), m(t), h(t), n(t), I_Na(t), and I_K(t) at 6.3 C for solver verification.

items.title: Allen Cell Types Human Cortical L2/3 & L5 Patch-Clamp Step Responses
items.attributionText: Allen Cell Types Database (brain-map.org); de-identified human surgical tissue whole-cell patch-clamp recordings.
items.description: Subthreshold and suprathreshold current-clamp voltage traces illustrating human pyramidal spike-frequency adaptation and sag.

items.title: DANDI Extracellular Multi-Unit Hippocampal CA1 Theta & Place-Spiking Epoch
items.attributionText: DANDI Archive open NWB neurophysiology subset (Rübel et al., 2022).
items.description: Simultaneous CA1 local field potential (theta 6–8 Hz) and sorted pyramidal/interneuron spike trains.

items.title: ModelDB Bi & Poo (1998) Hippocampal STDP Timing-Window Reference Points
items.attributionText: Bi & Poo (1998) J. Neurosci. / ModelDB reference synaptic modification dataset.
items.description: Paired pre/post spike timing intervals Delta_t (-100 to +100 ms) and resulting percentage EPSC potentiation/depression.

items.title: OpenNeuro BIDS Eyes-Closed vs Eyes-Open Occipital Alpha EEG Subset
items.attributionText: OpenNeuro BIDS resting-state EEG educational subset (Markiewicz et al., 2021; Gorgolewski et al., 2016; CC0 1.0).
items.description: 16-channel 10-20 scalp EEG epoch showing strong posterior 8–12 Hz alpha rhythm during eyes-closed relaxation vs Berger suppression on eye opening.

items.title: OpenNeuro BIDS Visual Evoked Potential (P100 / N170) Trial-Ensemble Subset
items.attributionText: OpenNeuro BIDS visual ERP educational subset (CC0 1.0).
items.description: 40 stimulus-locked EEG trials (-200 to +600 ms) demonstrating single-trial noise reduction and P100/N170 ERP extraction.

items.title: Human 68-Region Structural Connectome & Tract-Length Matrix Benchmark
items.attributionText: Consensus group-average 68-region Desikan-Killiany structural connectivity weight and tract-length matrices.
items.description: 68x68 symmetric structural connectivity weight matrix W_ij and fiber distance matrix d_ij (mm) for whole-brain modeling.

items.title: Human 68-Region Empirical Resting-State Functional Connectivity Matrix
items.attributionText: Group-average 68-region resting-state functional correlation matrix paired with DSET-017.
items.description: 68x68 empirical functional connectivity matrix highlighting Default Mode, Frontoparietal, Visual, and Somatomotor modules.

items.title: CORTEXIA Synthetic Ground-Truth Multi-Sine, Chirp & 50/60 Hz Line-Noise Benchmark
items.attributionText: CORTEXIA deterministic DSP verification generator (Seed 42).
items.description: Exact mathematical test signal containing 10 Hz alpha, 40 Hz gamma bursts, linear chirp, and 50 Hz artifact for validating filters, Welch PSD, and Morlet wavelets.

items.title: CORTEXIA Synthetic Ground-Truth Poisson, Refractory & Gamma-Modulated Spike Trains
items.attributionText: CORTEXIA deterministic spike-train verification generator (Seed 42).
items.description: 50 synthetic spike trains with known analytical firing rates, CV_ISI=1.0 vs 0.2, Fano factor, and 2.0 ms monosynaptic cross-correlation peaks.

items.title: CORTEXIA Synthetic White-Noise Stimulus & LIF Spike-Triggered Average (STA) Benchmark
items.attributionText: CORTEXIA deterministic reverse-correlation benchmark (Seed 42).
items.description: Gaussian white-noise current trace and resulting LIF spike times with known exponential integration kernel for STA validation.

items.title: CORTEXIA Synthetic Canonical Graph Topologies (Ring Lattice, Watts-Strogatz, Modular & Scale-Free)
items.attributionText: CORTEXIA deterministic graph-theory test suite (Seed 42).
items.description: Four reference adjacency matrices with exact analytical clustering C, path length L, modularity Q, and hub centrality for verifying MOD-06/MOD-11 graph algorithms.
